name: MUXIS v1.2.9 — Prismatic Aura
body:
### What's New in MUXIS v1.2.9
- Official iOS / iPhone build (`Muxis-iOS.ipa` + `Muxis-iOS-Unsigned.zip`) with opaque AppIcon assets, background audio (`UIBackgroundModes: [audio]`), Control Center/Lock Screen Now Playing, SafeArea iPhone UI polish, and iPhone Files integration (`On My iPhone -> MUXIS`)
- Whole-Device Storage Music Scan in Library Import for both Android phones (`/storage/emulated/0` + external SD cards with runtime `READ_MEDIA_AUDIO`/`READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permissions and resilient restricted-folder skipping) and iPhone (deep scan of MUXIS Files container, Inbox, imported vault, and remembered folders, plus persistent offline copy when picking from iCloud Drive / On My iPhone)
